english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a job or activity that occupies the person’s full working time.
Use this when the point is that the occupation is someone’s full-time paid livelihood, rather than their professional standard or mock-expert behavior.

examples.english: I'm working as a full-time nurse now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 cyun4 zik1 wu6 si6

examples.english: They quit their part-time job and now work as a full-time professional photographer.
examples.traditional: 佢辭咗份兼職，而家做全職攝影師。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gim1 zik1 ji4 gaa1 zou6 cyun4 zik1 sip3 jing2 si1
